title: Unit – 5 : Session – 9 : SLO – 1  |  Common Tkinter Widgets
sections: 1. Widget that collects user input — tk.Entry (single-line text input).
2. Widget for multi-line text input — tk.Text.
3. Two display-only widgets — tk.Label (text/images) and tk.Message (multi-line read-only text); tk.Canvas can also serve for graphics display.
Entry: single-line input — value read with entry.get().
Text: multi-line input — value read with text.get("1.0", tk.END).
Label: static display; Button: clickable action; Checkbutton/Radiobutton: option selection.
